description.name: Entry
description.text:
Tactical Awoken Mode, +500 ATK & +500 MAG to user
Tactical Awoken Mode: Ice/Dark Ability Boost, Triplecast Ice/Dark, Unlimited Ice/Dark Hones, Cap Break Level 1 to Ice/Dark Abilities, Ice/Dark Ability Damage +30% & 20% DEF/RES Pierce to Ice/Dark Abilities; Ends after using 8 Ice/Dark abilities
TP Max: AOE Ice/NE or Dark/NE hybrid attack at True Cap Break Level 1 under En-Ice or En-Dark

description.name: Weapon Skill
description.text:
Single-target Ice/Dark/NE piercing hybrid attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant ATB 1 & Instant Cast 1 to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & 30% DEF/RES Pierce to Ice/Dark Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold with at least Lv.0/2 En-Ice/Dark
WS Blue: Lv.2 En-Ice/Dark Stack to user
WS Gold: During Tactical Awoken Mode, chases an Ice/Dark ability with Quick ATB 3 (max 1 chase) to user
